title: Websites
intro: Each website shows the listings its inventory policy selects, with its own reference prefix, languages and contact details. Website API keys are bound to one website. Changes reach the website within a minute.
empty: No websites yet. Creating an API key also creates one.

form.name: Name
form.policyHint: Network listings are other agencies' public listings shared with you; they appear under your branding.
form.anyHint: Select none for any. Hold Ctrl (Cmd on a Mac) to select several.
form.priceHint: Listings priced on request are left out when a price band is set.
form.minCommissionHint: Network listings whose total commission is below this share of the price, or that have none (or a fixed commission on a price on request), are left out. Your own listings are never filtered by it. Needs network listings.
form.prefixHint: Up to 6 capital letters or digits, shown before network listings' references. Leave empty for none.
form.localesHint: Language codes separated by commas, the default first (en, es).
form.contact: Contact details shown on this website
form.contactHint: Leave empty to show the agency's own.

notices.saved: Website saved. Its listings follow within a minute.

errors.FORBIDDEN: Only agency admins can change websites.
errors.SITE_LIMIT_REACHED: Your agency has as many websites as allowed.
errors.VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: Showing other agencies' listings needs a verified agency.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this website meanwhile. Reload and try again.

feed.title: XML feed
feed.intro: Your website's listings as Kyero v3 and generic XML, for portals and web designers. The address contains a secret token: share it only with whoever imports the feed.
feed.kyeroCount: {count, plural, one {# in the Kyero feed} other {# in the Kyero feed}}
feed.genericCount: {count, plural, one {# in the generic feed} other {# in the generic feed}}
feed.lastError: The last update failed ({code}). It is retried automatically.
feed.rotateHint: The current addresses stop working at once.
feed.issuedIntro: They are shown only this once. If you lose them, create a new token.
feed.turnedOff: The feed is off. Its addresses now answer 404.

errors.FORBIDDEN: Only agency admins can change the feed.
errors.VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: The feed needs a verified agency.

feed.embedIntro: Paste this address in an iframe on {domains}. Other sites cannot show these pages.
feed.embedNoDomain: Add the domains of the website that shows these pages: they can only be framed there.
